learning_outcomes.text: Selects appropriate internal and external factory transport equipment, machines, and systems.
Performs strength calculations for transport system elements.
Analyzes the differences between bridge cranes, gantry cranes, and tower cranes.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course, explanation of its operation. Taking student suggestions and expectations. History of transport engineering.
Definition and classification of transport systems to be taught within the scope of the course.
Determination of semester transport engineering in-course design projects, creation of input quantities and design inputs.

Discontinuous (Intermittent) conveyors: Classification, design principles. Single-directional transport equipment, jacks, screw jacks, design principles, shaping, dimensioning, example project. Screw jack project assignment.
Rack and pinion jacks: design principles, shaping, dimensioning, example project, short quiz.

Pulley and rope arrangements: definition, classification and definition of basic elements. Design, selection, and calculations of rope, chain, pulley, drum, load securing elements. Hoists: definition, classification, design principles. Simple hoists, Weston hoists.

Safety elements and motor selection in transport engineering. Brake systems: definition, classification, design principles. Belt, disc, shoe, conical, etc. brakes. Locks: definition, classification, design principles. Form-fitting (geared), force-fitting (friction).
Hoist design: determination of input quantities, preliminary shaping, strength calculations, element selections, safety checks, final shaping.
Cranes: Classification, design principles. Bridge cranes, gantry cranes, semi-gantry cranes, tower cranes, slewing cranes, mobile cranes, capstan winches, construction winches.

Classification of transport systems according to European Union norms; determination of system group and safety factor according to loading condition and load repetition. Bridge cranes, gantry and semi-gantry cranes, determination of input quantities, preliminary shaping.
Bridge crane project: determination of input quantities, preliminary shaping, strength calculations, element selections, safety checks, final shaping. Student project presentation.

Continuous Conveyors: Classification, design principles. Elevators, conveyors, elevators, helical conveyors, pneumatic conveyors. Elevator Design: determination of input quantities, preliminary shaping, strength calculations, element selections, safety checks.
Belt conveyor design: determination of input quantities, preliminary shaping, strength calculations, element selections, safety checks, final shaping. Student project presentation.
Vibratory Conveyors, Vacuum Conveyors, Magnetic Conveyors, Other special transport systems, transport system design, general evaluation of the course.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated from 60% of the in-year performance and 40% of the final exam. The in-year performance is composed of 40% for the midterm exam, 5% for quiz 1, 10% for assignment 1, 30% for project/design, 5% for quiz 2, 5% for quiz 3, and 5% for quiz 4.
